main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise. A 1,885m oval featuring fully cambered turns and a 400m home straight with a subtle rise between the 600m and 400m marks. Rebuilt with a state-of-the-art sand drainage profile. Plays fair when rail is True, but when the rail moves out (+3m or further) or under evening dew during night racing cards, an aggressive inside-to-middle on-pace bias often materializes.
main_turf.post_bias: In 1000m-1100m sprints, only ~150m-200m exists before the first corner; inside barriers (1-4) hold a major advantage. In 1200m races starting in the backstretch chute, wide draws (8+) face a difficult 3-wide trip around tight turns. In 1400m races, the 400m backstretch run provides one of the course's fairest starts. In 1800m+ route races, inside draws (1-4) save vital energy entering the first turn.

polytrack_synthetic.bias_notes: Clockwise inner synthetic track. Features tighter turns and a 350m straight. Kickback is minimal, but the surface acts as a true grinding environment that demands high fitness. Rewards tactical speed and well-conditioned pressers who can maintain a true, even tempo without getting hooked wide.
polytrack_synthetic.post_bias: Inside barriers (2-5) hold a massive statistical advantage in Polytrack sprints (1000m-1200m) with win rates exceeding 20%. Wide draws (7+) get caught 3-wide on tight turns, making ground recovery extremely difficult.

handicapping_angles.the_magic_millions_class_spike: During the January Magic Millions Carnival, local Queensland provincial form lines are completely invaded by elite Tier 1 metropolitan stables from Sydney and Melbourne. Heavily downgrade local provincial horses competing against high-class interstate shippers.
handicapping_angles.polytrack_fitness_and_barrier_bias: On the Polytrack, disregard turf-based turn-of-foot metrics. Heavily upgrade horses with proven synthetic records, high gate speed, and draw in Barriers 1 through 5. Penalize under-conditioned turf stayers or wide-drawn closers.
handicapping_angles.night_racing_moisture_effect: During twilight and night cards under broadcast lights, coastal dew settles onto the turf surface as ambient temperatures drop. This often speeds up the track and heavily favors horses racing on the pace or 'one-off' the rail.
handicapping_angles.1200m_chute_trap: Be wary of wide draws (8+) in 1200m turf races. With only ~200m to the first corner, wide runners are frequently forced to either burn excessive fuel to cross or get trapped 3-wide without cover.
handicapping_angles.australian_weight_bifurcation: In QLD Benchmark/Handicap races (BM58-BM78), top weights carrying 59kg+ face a strict penalty (1kg = ~1 length). In Magic Millions Open / Set Weights & Penalties or WFA feature races, ignore minor weight spreads and prioritize peak class and rated form.
